Indicator Name: Number of community and frontline health workers supported by Last Mile Health and its government partners to provide quality community-based primary healthcare services
Definition: The definition of community and frontline health workers includes CHAs and CHSS as measured by the National CHA Program Master List. CHPs are also considered CHWs and part of the NCHAP and will likely be added to this definition once the policy is fully launched and training begins; targets will also be updated accordingly.

TOC Description: Organization-wide indicators aggregated across all country programs
Indicator Name: Population of the communities with improved access to quality, community-based primary healthcare through Last Mile Health and its government partners
Definition: Number of people served by the Liberia NCHAP annually (or during the strategic period), both LMH-managed and Not Managed areas.  Previously, managed area population is based on the number of households in the CBIS Household Registration form or mapping data for a community, whichever is most current, multiplied by 6 persons (average household size). The population served in the Not Managed areas is based on number of CHAs reported in the NCHAP National Dashboard multiplied by 235 persons.  Total area population is the sum of the LMH Managed and Not Managed area populations. In FY24 Q4, we began using the 235 people per CHA multiplier to calculate populations served in both managed and non-managed counties.
Data Source:
Liberia Community-based Information Systems (CBIS) & Community Health Worker Master List (Currently under development)      

Number of CHAs (from CHW Master List) * 235
Contributing Activities: Contributing Activities: National Community Health Program (managed counties and national technical assistance)

TOC Description: Advise & advocate for strong community health systems
Indicator Name: Community health system strengthened through technical advisory investments in leadership, governance, and management
Definition: LMH will partner with the Government of Liberia, donors and stakeholders to strengthen management systems that facilitate the transfer of management and governance for Grand Gedeh (GG) county from LMH to Liberia MOH County Health Teams (CHT). This will help establish a model for future transitions and LMOH ownership of NCHAP.
Notes: This KPI speaks to the transitioning of Grand Gedeh to the Liberia CHT.  This is a significant shift of responsibility and will establish a model for future transitions and NCHAP ownership.

TOC Description: Advise & advocate for strong community health systems
Indicator Name: Fidelity to National Community Health Policy
Definition: Percent of CHAs who reported receiving correct, on-time payment in the last 4 weeks during IFI assessment; Percent of CHAs who reported receiving 2 or more CHSS supervision visits in the last 4 weeks during IFI assessment; Percent of CHAs who reported having all community health tracer drugs/life-saving commodities (ACT25, ACT50, amoxicillin, ORS, zinc) in stock on the day of the IFI assessment
Contributing Activities: IFI, Health Finance, Supply Chain, Performance Management, National TA
Notes: Note: Annuals are calculated as the average of all CHAs reporting over the course of the year; while the IFI indicators are reported on a quarterly basis, they should only be interpreted on an annual basis (by the end of the year, will be representative of the population).

TOC Description: Advise & advocate for strong community health systems
Indicator Name: Percent of counties with current secured financial investments for the NCHP for the next six months
Definition:
Percent based on number of counties with secured financial support for the next six months / total number of counties in Liberia (n=15).  Secured financial support means each county's donor/implementer partners have indicated that the CHA program in "their county" is fully funded for the next six months.  Fully funded means sufficient funding to implement the NCHP at the recommended scale targets.

Note: Annuals are calculated as the average of all CHAs reporting over the course of the year; while the IFI indicators are reported on a quarterly basis, they should only be interpreted on an annual basis (by the end of the year, will be representative of the population).

TOC Description: Advise and advocate for strong community health systems

Definition: LMH supports in different ways, financially and technically, proving a Technical Advisor that sits with MOH as part of the development and deployment of iCHIS.  MOH owns the process, while LMH is the 'product owner' helping drive the process forward and managing M&E of the system.

TOC Description: Advise and advocate for strong community health systems
Indicator Name: Ethiopia MOH institutionalizes LMH's blended learning approach for HEW integrated refresher training
Definition: Institutionalizing here refers to the government adopting the blended learning approach piloted by LMH, and adapting it to other modules in the Integrated Refresher Training plan, to be scaled nationally on a gradual basis. Modules are considered to be adapted to the blended approach when the MOH requests the development of blended design for that module and LMH team completes blended instructional design, field testing, and uploads to the training app. A blended training module is considered in the stage of scale-up when MOH begins implementation/training with the training tools and blended learning approach developed by LMH.
Notes: There are six IRT modules: RMNCH, NCDs, MCDs, Environmental Health and Hygiene, Social Behavioural Communication and Change, and First Aid. Additionally, we are planning to develop a training module on e-CHIS.  This indicator reflects MOH's adoption of these modules for nation-wide use.

TOC Description: Train and grow the community health workforce
Indicator Name: Number of community and frontline health workers who have completed a full blended learning training module
Definition: Number of unique HEWs, HEW Supervisors, and other FHWs implementing the HEP at health posts who have completed at least one full blended learning training module annually.
Data Source: Extension Essentials training app (module registration, attendance, activity completion)
Notes: A learner is considered to have completed a module if they attended the training, received the training module on the Extensions Essentials app, and completed the post-training knowledge assessment or post-training skills assessment.

TOC Description: Train and grow the community health workforce
Indicator Name: Total number of blended training module completions by community and frontline health workers
Definition: Total number of blended training module completions by HEWs, HEW Supervisors, and other FHWs implementing the HEP at health posts annually (or cumulatively since the start of the country program). This indicator counts each completion of a training by a health worker (e.g. if one health worker completes 3 trainings modules, it counts as 3).
Data Source: Extension Essentials training app (module registration, attendance, activity completion)
Notes: A module is considered complete if the learner attended the training, received the training module on the Extensions Essentials app, and completed the post-training knowledge assessment or skills assessment.

TOC Description: Train and grow the community health workforce
Indicator Name: Percentage of HEWs and HEW Supervisors who have received a passing score in a post-training knowledge assessment
Definition: Percentage calculated from number of HEWs and HEW Supervisors who have earned a passing grade (75%) on post-training knowledge assessment / total number of HEWs and HEW Supervisors assessed.
Notes: For FY22-24, the passing threshold for knowledge assessments was set at 75%. This was changed to 60% at the beginning of FY25 to align with Ethiopia's TVET (Technical and Vocational Education and Training) standards. The FY actuals displayed align with the passing thresholds that were set at the time of calculation (FY22-24: 75%; FY25-onward: 60%).

TOC Description: Train and grow the community health workforce
Indicator Name: Percentage of HEWs and HEW Supervisors who have received a passing score in a post-training skills assessment
Definition: Percentage calculated from number of HEWs and HEW Supervisors who have earned a passing grade (75%) on post-training skills assessment / total number of HEWs and HEW Supervisors assessed.
Notes: For FY22-24, the passing threshold for skills assessments was set at 75%. This was changed to 80% at the beginning of FY25 to align with Ethiopia's TVET (Technical and Vocational Education and Training) standards. The FY actuals displayed align with the passing thresholds that were set at the time of calculation (FY22-24: 75%; FY25-onward: 80%).
